title: GSAP overkill — replace with CSS animations
description: GSAP 6.4 MB is imported only for 2 trivial entrance animations in BubbleExpanded.tsx and Toast.tsx. Both could be replaced with CSS @keyframes (same pattern already used in globals.css). This would save ~50-60 KB from renderer JS bundle and eliminate 6.4 MB from node_modules.
resolution: GSAP removed from BubbleExpanded.tsx and Toast.tsx. Replaced with CSS @keyframes (tab-fade-in + existing toast-enter/toast-exit). package.json updated. pnpm-lock updated. Verification: typecheck 0, lint 0, tests 25/25.
